description.zh:
排序方向。取值：
- DESC：递减（为空时默认递减排序） 
- ASC: 递增
description.en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

- DESC: Descending order. This is the default value.

- ASC: Ascending order.

description.zh:
域名类型，大小写不敏感。取值：

- PUBLIC：权威托管域名（默认值）

- CACHE：权威代理域名
description.en:
The type of the domain name. This parameter is not case-sensitive. Valid values:

- PUBLIC: authoritative domain name (default)

- CACHE: authoritative proxy domain name

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：
- zh：中文
- en：英文

默认：en
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: en

description.zh:
排序参数。取值：
- createDate：按创建时间排序（为空时默认按创建时间排序）
- expireDate：按过期时间排序
description.en:
The field to sort the results by. Valid values:

- createDate: Sorts the results by creation time. This is the default value.

- expireDate: Sorts the results by expiration time.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为**1**，默认为**1**。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from **1**. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值**100**，默认为**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **20**.
The edition code of the Alibaba Cloud DNS instance.

title.zh: 获取付费版DNS产品实例列表

descriptions.zh: > **如果返回参数中未包含域名，则表示该云解析产品尚未绑定任何域名。**
descriptions.en: > **If the response does not contain a domain name, the Alibaba Cloud DNS instance is not associated with any domain names.**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-dns-product-instances --lang en --user-client-ip 192.0.2.0 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --version-code version1 --domain-type PUBLIC --order-by createDate --direction DESC --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeDnsProductInstances --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy createDate --VersionCode version1 --DomainType PUBLIC --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --UserClientIp '192.0.2.0' --Lang en --Direction DESC
